paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 106a; Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 106a has Rav Idi bar Shisha (בר שישא). Hyman’s heading has bar Shishi (בר שישי), and he reports the reversed chain Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi from Dikdukei Soferim.

The named William Davidson Pesachim 106a paragraph explicitly writes Rav Idi bar Shisha (בר שישא), beside Hyman’s bar Shishi (בר שישי). Hyman’s reported Dikdukei Soferim reading reverses the chain to Rav Shishi son of Rav Idi; that apparatus has not been freshly collated here. The existing note and all three supplied forms remain distinct, without a father-son reversal, Hebrew repair or identity harmonization.
